name: Global Minimality of the Pentagonal Obstruction
statement: The pentagonal obstruction has the smallest isometric dimension among the ample members of the complete basis, is the unique additional obstruction of dimension five and order at most twenty-one, and no additional obstruction has fewer than sixteen vertices.
proof: Exact coordinate-isomorphism enumeration excludes additional types through dimension four. In dimension five through order twenty-one it produces 14,259 partial-cube representatives and 3,115 periphery-free representatives, with $\mathcal P_5$ the unique additional minimal type. Exact searches in dimensions six through twelve exclude ample periphery-free families below order sixteen; the low-excess lemma and the dimension/order bound cover all remaining dimensions.
comments: The database preserves the compact exact census reports and verifies their declared counts; the full raw enumeration archive remains in the LaTeX research repository.
